note: The Columbus City Charter, as quoted in the city's 2022 elected official compensation report, says the mayor is elected for a term of four years. The city's charter review report states that the regular municipal election is held in every odd-numbered year. The mayor is elected in 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023 on a four-year cycle, so no regular mayoral election falls in this even-numbered year. The Franklin County Board of Elections page for this year lists its elections; no special mayoral election appears in the 2010-2026 results documents reviewed.
